item.title: Core Keeper Meadow & Ranching Seeds — Moolin, Bambuck and Wool Farms
item.description: Meadows are the best early-game side hustle in Core Keeper. They are the only peaceful sub-biome in The Undergrounds, and they are home to Moolin (Meadow Milk) and Bambuck (Wool) — two resources you otherwise grind for hours. The catch: meadows are rare, angular, and you have to find them before they wander off into a fight. These community-verified seeds put meadows on your doorstep. Why we recommend these seeds Seed What you get Who it’s for 987654321000 Multiple meadows near the Core Ranchers who want a big wool/milk farm fast 919045411111 Meadow with the rare green Moolin variant Completionists and collectors Both seeds trade raw ore density for livestock convenience — you still mine copper and tin normally.
